parameter_provenance.C_tot_uM: 30-80, baseline 50 (Lorimer 1996 GroEL ~30 uM; DnaK 30-50 uM) -- proteostasis-P1/LITERATURE_ANCHORS.md
parameter_provenance.theta: NOT measured; introduced here to expose the model's implicit assumption that 100% of the chaperone pool is available to the damaged-protein pool

correction_to_earlier_claim: scripts/09 attributed the 98%-saturated folding arm to a parameterization inconsistent with the paper's own capacity evidence. That was wrong: C_tot and K_d are properly sourced and used in range. The saturation is structural -- the model omits the nascent-chain folding load, so it hands the entire chaperone pool to the damaged pool.
what_would_pin_this_down: a measurement of chaperone occupancy by nascent-chain folding in exponentially growing E. coli would fix theta and collapse the headroom range to a point
